description: This file defines TypeScript types and interfaces for managing browser server state, profiles, and related functionalities within a browser extension or server context. It includes types for runtime state, server state, profile actions, route context, profile status, and configuration options.

methods.name: ensureBrowserAvailable
methods.description: Ensures that a browser instance is available before performing further actions.

methods.name: ensureTabAvailable
methods.description: Ensures that a specific tab is available, optionally targeting a specific tab ID.

methods.name: isHttpReachable
methods.description: Checks if the HTTP endpoint is reachable within an optional timeout.

methods.name: isReachable
methods.description: Checks general reachability of the browser instance within an optional timeout.

methods.name: listTabs
methods.description: Returns a list of open browser tabs.

methods.name: openTab
methods.description: Opens a new tab with the specified URL.

methods.name: focusTab
methods.description: Brings the specified tab into focus.

methods.name: resetProfile
methods.description: Resets the browser profile, possibly moving it to a new location.

methods.name: forProfile
methods.description: Retrieves the profile context for a given profile name.

methods.name: mapTabError
methods.description: Maps an error encountered with a tab to a standardized status message and code.

methods.name: state
methods.description: Returns the current state of the browser server.
